twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication (2FA)
twoFactor.description: At login, ask for a code from an authenticator app in addition to the password.
twoFactor.scan: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, 2FAS…), then type the 6-digit code it shows.
twoFactor.secret: Or type this key in the app:
twoFactor.backupHint: Save these codes somewhere safe. Each one lets you log in once if you lose your phone.
twoFactor.done: 2FA is enabled. The next login will ask for a code.
twoFactor.oauthOnly: This account uses the 42 login and has no password: its security (2FA included) is managed on the 42 intra.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Your username is shown to other players and in your profile address.

errors.invalid: Something went wrong. Please try again.

collect.title: Data we collect
collect.body: When you create an account, we store your username, email address, a hashed version of your password, your avatar if you upload one, and your game history. If you sign in with 42, we receive your 42 login and public profile information.

use.title: How we use it
use.body: Your data is only used to run the service: authenticate you, display your profile, match you with other players, and compute statistics and leaderboards. We do not sell your data or use it for advertising.

storage.title: Storage and security
storage.body: Data is stored in a database hosted by the project team. Passwords are never stored in plain text and all traffic is encrypted with HTTPS.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can view and edit your profile at any time. You can request a copy of your data or the deletion of your account by contacting us.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: This is a student project from 42 Le Havre. For any question about your data, contact the team through the project repository.

acceptance.title: Acceptance
acceptance.body: By creating an account or using Transcendence, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.

account.title: Your account
account.body: You are responsible for keeping your credentials secret and for all activity on your account. Your username must not impersonate someone else or be offensive.

conduct.title: Fair play
conduct.body: Cheating, exploiting bugs, harassing other players or disrupting the service is forbidden and may lead to suspension of your account.

service.title: Service availability
service.body: Transcendence is a student project provided as is, without any guarantee of availability. Features may change or be removed at any time.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: These terms may be updated. The date at the top of this page shows the latest version.
